archive/reference-py/apps/csih/probes/slice_env.py reason: not ported yet, and as written it cannot fit the 55s budget: it edits a private copy of the tree (tui.cx changes every run), so unisacc's -run cache always misses and the in-agent tui slice compiles cold (~47s) inside a 14s exec limit, after a cold agent_cli build (~28s). Needs a prebuilt slice binary or a cheaper slice target before it can run.

archive/reference-py/apps/csih/probes/reload_launcher.py reason: run loop ported 2026-10-30; reload-launcher-run covers one commit and one rollback (after FREEZE) with the draft carried and the terminal restored. Not ported: two successive commits, a bad source build (build-failed, still editable), /export-state contents, the REJECT of a NUL-op ACTIVATE, the rollback-by-ignored-ACK variant

column8: reload_launcher.cx run loop (ported 2026-10-30 on cx/sys: tcgetpgrp, socketpair, spawn_inherit, fork_session/setsid, killpg, tty_get/tty_set): probes/reload_launcher_run.cx drives the launcher in a private tmux pane with real csih actors: initial build+ACTIVATE, REQUEST->committed handoff (READY/FROZEN/RELEASED/ACK/activated/committed, old retired, draft carried), second launcher refused by the supervisor lock, no-tty refusal, failed COMMIT rolled back (handoff-failed, candidate-exited, RESUMED), /exit rc0 with stty -g unchanged and lock free. Candidates come from a replay compiler (reload_candidate's 14s command limit cannot hold a csih compile); launcher/agent_cli binaries cached in out/csih-launcher-run keyed by compiler + -cx-plan closure. A cold cache (~28s compile) plus the run measured 56s against the 55s budget: after a change to either closure run `U -run probes/reload_launcher_run.cx -- --prepare` first (builds the cache only, prints PREPARED, verifies nothing)
